name: Vroxel
summary:
Vroxel: Your Universe in Every Cube

Introduction
Vroxel is an intuitive voxel modeling program built specifically for virtual reality. We have reimagined the process of creating digital art, making it as natural as sculpting with clay yet offering the limitless possibilities of the digital world. Vroxel breaks down the barriers between game design, 3D art, and architectural prototyping, giving users a unique creative experience in an immersive environment.
